meta.title: The Founding Partner program — Mobilcab
meta.description: Join the Founding Partner waitlist: when we open the paid Basic plan with M2 (design, cut lists, nesting, labels, quotes), you get 20% off. Anyone who subscribes later pays full list price.

hero.label: The Founding Partner program
hero.title: Help shape the tool Romanian workshops actually need.
hero.body: We're not looking for testers for unfinished software. We're looking for workshops to build it with us. Join the Founding Partner waitlist for free; when we ship M2 and open the paid Basic plan, people on that list get 20% off. Anyone who subscribes later pays full list price.

counter.full: All {total} Founding Partner spots have been claimed.

items.title: A place on the Founding Partner waitlist, free
items.body: You pay nothing to join. The 20% discount applies only when we open the paid Basic plan with M2 — and only if you choose to subscribe.

items.title: 20% off the Basic plan at M2
items.body: The Basic plan (M1+M2) covers design, cut lists, sheet nesting, labels and client quotes. Founding Partners: 20% off list, 6 months from first payment. Anyone who comes later, without a waitlist place, pays full list. We announce list amounts when we're ready.

items.title: A say in what we build
items.body: Tell us what's missing in your workshop, and your ideas go straight into the roadmap.

items.title: Your name, as a Founding Partner
items.body: You're listed among the people who helped build Mobilcab.

items.title: Private feedback group
items.body: Talk directly with the founders and the other Founding Partners.

items.title: Personal notice when payment opens
items.body: We contact you when the paid Basic plan (M2) is ready, with list price and your discount — before the FP offer closes.

offer.title: The Founding Partner offer
offer.yearly: off the Basic plan at M2 · free to join now
offer.detail: When we ship M2 and open the paid Basic plan, people on the Founding Partner waitlist buy at 20% off list (6 months). Anyone who wants the paid plan later pays full list price. Waitlist places are limited; we'll say when we close sign-ups.
offer.noPayment: Joining is free and doesn't commit you to anything. If you don't want to pay when the Basic plan opens, you decline — and that's it.

ai.title: What Basic covers at M2
ai.body: 3D design, cut lists, sheet nesting, labels and client quotes — the workshop flow through to a quote. Founding Partners: 20% off list, 6 months from first payment.
